visual_fixes: Scoped global container top padding so composer fits desktop and mobile viewport.
Made mobile global sidebar close a keyboard button with accessible name and focus return.
Kept download actions visible when terminal snapshot arrives.
Added terminal result error alert and de-duplicated current restored receipt.
limitations: Snapshots, classifications, progress, reviews and monetary values are simulations.
No live worker/provider/authentication integration was performed in browser; separate backend tests cover those boundaries.
XLSX spreadsheet preview was not rendered during this browser QA; existing data workflow remains covered separately.
No automated WCAG/assistive-technology certification; specific keyboard, focus and ARIA behaviors were checked.
Artifact design and factual validation are separate from UI QA. Deck images shown here are sparse; this is source content, not UI clipping.
